headline: Public hearings on requests to change approval conditions for 36 and 44 Pillsbury Road.
summary: The current approval allows certificates of occupancy only after all off-site improvements are done. The applicant, Procopio Enterprises, Inc., asks to change that, under an agreement with town staff.
items: Amend approval conditions for 36 Pillsbury Road
Amend approval conditions for 44 Pillsbury Road
item_action_words: Public hearing of an application for an amendment
Public hearing of an application for an amendment

New Plans/Conceptual Plans
Public hearing of an application for an amendment to the conditions of the 
approval granted by the Planning Board on April 8, 2026, which only allows for 
the issuance of certificates of occupancy after all off-site improvements are 
complete. An Off-Site Improvement agreement between town staff and the 
applicant agreed to the terms and conditions which included a provision for the 
issuance of a limited number of certificates of occupancy to be granted before 
completion. 36 Pillsbury Road , zoned Woodmont Commons (PUD) and 
Agricultural Residential - 1 (AR-1). Pillsbury Realty Development, LLC owner 
and Procopio Enterprises, Inc (applicant).
